_comment: R-PERF baseline — measured 2026-06-21 on darwin/arm64, node 20.x, npx tsx.
_methodology: 10 iterations, warm JIT (tsx module cache), measurements sorted, p95 = arr[floor(N*0.95)]. Hook startup uses subprocess (npx tsx), so includes tsx module load. Recall uses real plugin .guild/wiki for warm path, /tmp empty dir for cold.
